text:
tess (Partnerships): Quick review please 1 - ZenithScale co-marketing pack uploaded (webinar hero, marketplace tile, one-sheet). Link: https://figma.com/file/zenith/zenith-redwood-webinar
omar (Design): Opening. Hero crop is fine but their logo uses a gradient that disappears at small sizes. Recommend flat monochrome badge for thumbnails.
ruth (PMM): Marketplace wants a partner-led CTA. Suggest 'Join ZenithScale Webinar' for the tile and 'Learn how to optimize inference' on landing.
jia (Legal): Need signed webinar consent and a short speaker release for any customer quotes. Also check that any benchmark numbers have provenance.
kai (Localization): I can make short CTA variants for JP, ES, and PT-BR. Also note character limits: JP title <30 chars for the marketplace.
omar (Design): Added a mono badge and exported 1:1 and 16:9 thumbnails at 1200px and 800px. Mono badge legible at 80px.
tess (Partnerships): Great. Ruth, can you soften the line 'reduces latency 40%' to 'observed up to 40% lower latency in internal tests' until we have a lab report?
ruth (PMM): Yep, will update copy. Jia, can you draft a one-paragraph speaker release template we can send to the partner?
jia (Legal): On it 1 - I'll post a template in >24h. Also flag: avoid absolute temperature claims in hardware notes.
asset-bot: Checklist: missing speaker release, signed webinar consent, localized CTAs, and alt text short/long variants. Due: 3 business days.
tess (Partnerships): Action items: 1) @omar keep mono badge for thumbnails, 2) @ruth update copy and attach benchmark link or soften claim, 3) @jia send release template and request consent, 4) @kai provide localized CTAs. I'll coordinate with ZenithScale PM for sign-off.
omar (Design): Will add alt text short/long into the Figma alt layer before EOD.
kai (Localization): I'll drop strings in thread once ready.
